levels.surface: أبو الحسن بن عمر [و] بن علي بن عبد الله البصري
أبو محمد خلف بن محمد البلخي

notes: «أبو الحسن بن عمر [و] بن علي» keeps the editor's brackets as written; one link.
«بها» after the Balkhi name is a place, not part of the name.
«عن أبيه محمد بن أحمد» is one link whose surface is the name alone (rule 7).

needs_ruling: Ata narrates his own presence («كنا عند ابن عباس») and the saying is Ibn Abbas's explanation, a first-person narrative with implicit transmission; Ibn Abbas is not added and Abu al-Aliya is in the scene only.
